action: He woke clear and steady, checked the fire, and sat down by the coals to plan with Wesley.
thought: River next. We're ready now.

action: He woke rested for the first time since the Cayenne broke, felt the difference in himself, and joined Chills by the fire.
thought: No fear this morning. Finally.

action: He stretched long and paced toward the forest edge with quick, alert steps, nose working the morning air.
thought: All safe. Time to hunt.

action: It rested deeper in the ferns as Mutu approached, not fleeing, and settled close enough that their warmth mingled.
thought: Orange one comes. Safe here.

description: Morning light finds Chills and Wesley at the fire, talking quietly about the river — the next real test — while Mutu hunts and the panther rests calm at the forest edge.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How far is it, really? To the main road?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Three, maybe four days. If the river lets us.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: And if it doesn't?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then we've got food, fire, and time. We figure it out.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I slept through the entire night without waking.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I know. First time you've let yourself rest here.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So yeah. I think we try the river.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Good. We'll prep today and move tomorrow.

action: Traces the river route on the map with a steady finger while Mutu dozes in his lap, speaking quietly about currents and safe crossing points.
thought: Tomorrow we cross. He won't break.

action: Sits across the fire, asking careful questions about the river and listening to Chills' steady voice, his earlier panic settling into focus and plan.
thought: Fear fades when he speaks so steady.

action: Curled warm in Chills' lap, one ear twitching toward the forest as the panther shifts in the ferns, the cat utterly unbothered.
thought: Safe. All safe here.

action: Rests low in the ferns at the clearing edge, watching the two humans and the orange cat with calm, steady eyes, neither fleeing nor advancing.
thought: Small one is safe. Dark ones hold still.

description: Wesley and Chills spend midday mapping the river crossing while Mutu dozes and the panther watches calmly from the ferns.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How high will the water be after yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Depends on the rain upriver. Should be passable by tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Passable is not safe. What if we misjudge the current?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We scout it first. Wade shallow, read the rocks. No rush.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You make it sound simple.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It's not. But panic doesn't help.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You've done this before, at least.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: First time for me too, with you at my shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's not reassuring.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Neither of us drowning is reassuring enough?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Fair point.

action: Stands on the river rocks midway across, scanning the water depth and current with a rope coiled at his side, checking the line he's laid for tomorrow's crossing.
thought: Water's good. He'll make it through.

action: Steps carefully from rock to rock beside Chills, gripping his arm once to steady himself, eyes tracking the water's pace and reading the map in his hand.
thought: Current's fast but the depth— I can calculate this.

action: Picks carefully through the shallows at the riverbank, paws quick and precise, nose down for small fish or crayfish in the deeper pools.
thought: Hunt is good here. Safe here.

action: Rests low in the ferns at the forest edge just above the river, watching Mutu hunt with steady eyes while the men work the crossing line upstream.
thought: Orange one is safe. I stay close.

description: Afternoon light settles on the river as Chills and Wesley stand on the crossing rocks, rope in hand and fear in check — tomorrow's crossing mapped out between them while Mutu hunts below and the panther rests silent in the ferns.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Water's high. How do we know it won't rise in the night?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Sky's clear. Rain brings it up. Tonight stays calm.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: And if we get caught mid-crossing and the current—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We won't. I've done this before. You've held it together these past days.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That was different. This is water we can drown in.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Water you've already beaten in your head. Twice over, probably.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So tomorrow, then.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Tomorrow.

action: Checks the rope and crossing gear by firelight, knotting and testing each piece with methodical calm.
thought: Tomorrow. We go. We're ready.

action: Sits by the fire tracing the rope knots they'll use tomorrow, hands steady and focused, fear folded into concentration.
thought: He's calm. That makes it possible.

action: Slinks back from the forest with a small bird, drops it by the fire at Chills' feet, then curls close beside him.
thought: He worries tomorrow. I bring food.

action: Rests in the fern hollow at the forest's edge, watching the firelight and Mutu, utterly still and at ease.
thought: Safe here. Orange one is safe.

description: By firelight on the eve of the river crossing, Chills checks their rope and gear while Wesley traces tomorrow's knots; Mutu brings a small catch to settle close, and the panther watches calmly from the ferns.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Current looked faster today than this morning.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Light plays tricks. We measured it.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I know. I'm just nervous.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Good. Fear keeps you sharp.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're not afraid.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Always am. Just don't show it.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That doesn't help.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: But you're not afraid alone. That's the point.

action: Chills tends the fire and runs his hand along the rope, checking every knot with steady certainty.
thought: Tomorrow we cross the water. I'm ready.

action: Wesley checks the rope obsessively, mind racing through drowning scenarios until he forces himself to breathe and trust.
thought: His steadiness makes this all possible.

action: Mutu brings a fresh kill and settles between them at the fire, purring close to Chills.
thought: They worry tomorrow. Food settles them.

action: The panther rests deeper in the ferns, utterly still, eyes reflecting the firelight in perfect calm.
thought: Orange one safe. Dark ones rest.

description: By the firelight on the eve of the crossing, Wesley checks the rope one last time while Chills steadies the fire; Mutu brings a fresh kill and settles close, and the panther watches calmly from the ferns.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The knots are right, but the current—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Current's fast. I've seen worse.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Not where I'm from. Nothing like this.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That's why you trust me now.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I do. That's what scares me.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Being afraid doesn't make you weak.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: What if the rope fails?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It won't. You checked it twice.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I keep thinking about drowning.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Stop. That's not helpful.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Tomorrow then.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We move together. That's the plan.

action: He wakes before dawn, washes in the river's shallows, and returns to check the rope one final time by firelight.
thought: Today. Steady. We've trained for this.

action: He wakes before dawn with a hollow feeling in his chest, mentally traces the route one more time, then joins Chills at the fire.
thought: I can do this. He has me.

action: He circles the camp once, hunting-restless in the early light, then settles on the Cayenne hood to watch.
thought: They move today. Something shifts.

action: It rests just inside the fern line, watching Mutu on the hood, and does not move as the two men prepare.
thought: Orange one here. Dark ones stay.

description: By the fire as morning light breaks through the canopy, Chills and Wesley coil the rope together one final time, hands steady, the day of the crossing finally here.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Rope's good. I've checked it twice since yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Good. Now let it go and trust the knots.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: It's still moving fast. The rain hit the flow hard.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We picked the right rocks. The rope is solid. You are solid.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I just need to hear that once more, I think.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Once more, then: you've got this. I'm with you all the way through.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: After we cross, we can't come back to the Cayenne.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We don't go back. We go forward. That's been the plan all along.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I know. But saying it out loud makes it real.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It's been real. We've just been getting ready to meet it.

action: Sits steady on a riverside rock, watching the current and Wesley's careful work below, breath even and ready.
thought: The river knows. So do we.

action: Wades into the shallows to check the rope tension and water depth one more time, hands moving with new precision.
thought: Stronger current. But we've trained for it.

action: Brings a small freshly-killed fish to the riverbank and settles on a sun-warmed rock, watching the water with alert green eyes.
thought: They worry. I can eat.

action: Watches from the forest edge across the water, body still, eyes following Mutu's small form on the rock below the ferns.
thought: Orange one safe in sun. I wait.

description: At the shallows in bright midday heat, Wesley checks the rope and water depth one final time while Chills watches from a nearby rock, both steadying themselves for tomorrow's crossing.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How deep at the crossing point?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Waist-high. We tested it yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The current's faster than yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Monsoon season. The rope will hold.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: What if something breaks tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We improvise. We're ready for it.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You make it sound simple.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It is simple. Just not easy.

action: In the late afternoon, Chills walks out to the shallows one final time to check the rope's lashing against the river rocks, tugging hard and nodding to himself before heading back to the fire.
thought: It holds. We hold. Tomorrow we go.

action: Wesley sits on the opposite side of the fire, staring at the water and running through the crossing one more time in his head, fingers unconsciously tracing the rope knot at his waist.
thought: Current's faster. But we've done harder.

action: Mutu drapes across Chills' lap, chin resting on his knee, utterly still and watching the water with the same focused intensity as the men.
thought: They worry. I stay close.

action: From the ferns at the forest's edge, the panther watches the firelight flicker across the men's faces, utterly calm and patient, inching closer to the camp's edge than it ever has before.
thought: Orange one is safe. I move nearer.

description: By late afternoon, Chills finishes a final rope check while Wesley watches from the opposite side of the fire; both quiet and ready, the river's roar a constant reminder of what waits at dawn.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Current's even stronger than this morning.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Good. Less chance of drifting downstream.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's one way to look at it.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Only way that helps.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're not scared at all, then?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Terrified. Just not useful to say it aloud.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Yeah. Okay.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Sleep well tonight. You'll need the strength.
